data_description.name: Leaving this empty names the instance "Sensor Fusion".
data_description.sensors: Pick at least two sensors measuring the same quantity. Sensors that are briefly unavailable are skipped while the estimate coasts.
data_description.volatility: How much the measured quantity moves between sensor updates, in units per square root of a minute. Raise it for fast-moving signals, lower it for steady ones.
data_description.bias_horizon_minutes: Minutes over which a sensor's bias is expected to drift by one maximum-bias step. Lower adapts faster, higher trusts the learned bias longer.
data_description.max_bias: The largest deviation from the true value a single sensor is expected to develop, in the measurement's unit.

user.description: Fuse redundant sensors into one drift-corrected estimate. See the [documentation]({documentation_url}) for tuning advice.

error.not_enough_sensors: Select at least two different sensors to fuse.
error.mismatched_sources: The selected sensors must share the same unit of measurement and device class.
